claims: Annual flu shots are recommended for everyone 6 months and older.
Flu shots are ideally administered in September or October to allow two weeks for immunity to build.
Flu vaccines prevent influenza infection.
Flu vaccines reduce symptom severity.
Flu vaccines protect against circulating strains.

For the 2024-2025 season, flu vaccines in the U.S. have transitioned to trivalent.
Trivalent flu vaccines protect against three influenza strains.
It takes about two weeks to build immunity after flu vaccination.
The CDC recommends getting vaccinated by the end of October.
